systems.value: Low voltage; up to 3 heat/2 cool heat pump, 2 heat/2 cool conventional
systems.note: The model name and one spec table say 3 heat/2 cool on heat pumps; another spec table on the same page says 2 heat/1 cool.

power.note: Honeywell's support article says the T5/T6 Pro Wi-Fi models require a common wire.

summary: The T6 Pro TH6320WF2003 from Honeywell Home is a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi wall thermostat for low-voltage systems: up to 3 heat and 2 cool stages on heat pumps, 2 and 2 on conventional. Honeywell's copy for this model names Apple Home and Amazon Echo. No hub is needed, but it requires a C-wire.
caveats: Needs a C-wire; Honeywell sells a C-wire adapter.
Sold through installers: Honeywell's page shows it as sold out with pricing from a pro, and one spec table lists fewer heat pump stages.
Google Home, SmartThings, Matter and Home Assistant support are not confirmed for this model.
